title: Kata Voltbench
description: Explore ideal linear circuits with SPICE-style netlists, DC operating points, source sweeps, AC magnitude and phase, and transient waveforms. An independent educational workbench inspired by HSPICE.
features: Ideal R, C, L, V and I devices
Local autosave and JSON project import/export
